nodes.label: VetoDrawer
nodes.rationale: Every drawer behaviour (persistent, temporary, mini rail, responsive) ships in one component selected via Variant, rather than the app choosing/writing one. The responsive behaviour is pure CSS - only the open/closed state is tracked in C# - so there is no viewport-width listener, no layout-shift on boot, and it behaves correctly in prerendered HTML before WASM starts. A one-time JS measurement (veto-layout.js matchesMinWidth) closes a responsive drawer that starts open on a narrow viewport, since a drawer defaulting to open would otherwise cover the whole screen on a phone; the stylesheet handles every width change after that.
